evidence: This is a ground texture of tan sand with scattered light and dark speckles and small ripple dashes. It has no object body, so the 3/4 top-and-front contract does not apply. It shows no front elevation, side face or slab, so nothing fails.

style.flat_fills_note: base tan is broken up by speckles every few pixels
style.evidence: The sand has about 5 tones: a mid tan base, a lighter tan, a darker ochre, a deeper brown and a cream highlight. Scattered speckles and small ripple dashes break up the base, so no 5x5 area is a flat fill. It has no outlines, which suits ground. The 16px pattern repeats identically across the 4x3 patch, so tiling is visible, and tiles carry roughly 5-6 colours against the richer grass and paving references. That makes density slightly lower, but it is acceptable beside the references, whose grass is similarly sparse.
